name: past
description: Your Claude Code sessions become memory, and every session starts briefed.

api_key.title: past.dev project API key
api_key.description: Starts with past_sk_. Create one in the past.dev console under Build > API keys.

identity.title: Your identity
identity.description: The email or id every memory is attributed to. Recall stays off without it.

api_url.title: API URL
api_url.description: Only for a self-hosted or staging deployment. Leave empty for https://api.past.dev.

audience.title: Audience
audience.description: Who in the project sees your sessions: an audience slug from the console. Leave empty for the whole project.
